title: TC-TIB-002 — [Happy path] Select from category - unchanged flow
steps:
Preconditions: Staging portal; an existing Additional Option category with at least 1 item

  1. Create a new Global Option, Type = Additional Option, add at least 1 inline item (creation always starts as Create new), Save
  2. On the Edit page that opens, switch source to Select from category
  3. Confirm the warning dialog
  4. Pick the existing Additional Option category
  5. Save
expectedResult:
Warning dialog appears before switching source away from Create new. After confirming and picking the category, the Global Option now sources from that category and behaves identically to the legacy flow on storefront.

Note: PO/DEV confirm — whether the initial Create new save can go through with 0 inline items (see TC-TIB-012); if not, at least 1 placeholder item is needed first to reach the Edit page.
actualResult:
Environment: staging-portal.teeinblue.com, store linh-tib-staging.myshopify.com.

Observed (direct): Created new Global Option, Type = Additional Option, Create new (default) with 1 inline item "Placeholder item", Save → redirected to /global-options/987/edit (same pattern as TC-001). On the Edit page, clicked "Select from category" → a confirm dialog appeared: "Change additional option source? Customizations and orders already made with this global option point to the items of the current source. After switching, they will no longer match the new items. Items of the current source are kept, so you can switch back later." Confirmed with "Switch source". Picked the existing category "Source additional option" (pre-existing category on this store, items 1/2/3) via the category picker. Preview panel updated to show items 1, 2, 3. Saved; reloaded the page from a fresh navigation and the selection persisted: Additional option = Select from category, Selected: "Source additional option", same 3 items shown.

Conclusion (direct observation): Warning dialog appears before switching source away from Create new, confirming and picking the category works, and the GO now sources from that category exactly as a legacy category-sourced Additional Option GO would. All parts of expected result verified directly (the PO/DEV-confirm note about 0-item saves was not needed since 1 item was added first).

Note: left GO id 987 ("New Additional Option option", now category-sourced from "Source additional option") on staging.
